title: Simple PvP Vanilla
description: Simple PvP Vanilla is a minimalist PvP resource pack that improves combat visibility while preserving Minecraft's vanilla style.
body: ![New !](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7a8386bd097cf21cde69c8913a7924f956df21e2.png) Simple PvP Vanilla is a minimalist PvP resource pack that enhances Minecraft's default visuals with clean textures and a refined design. It provides better combat visibility while preserving the game's classic vanilla style, making it an excellent choice for players looking for a clean, smooth, and effective PvP experience.
